integrity: The analytic proof supplies the infinite-dimensional and extension-field statements; the separately runnable code checks exact finite cutoff comparisons and independent small examples. The historical comparison is bounded, and no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem covers point-hyperplane incidence metrics of PG(d,q), d>=2 and q a prime power; it does not provide fixed-bandwidth Gaussian thresholds or general block-design classifications.
Computational examples cover only selected finite prime-field geometries.
Older generalized-roundness or association-scheme literature could contain an equivalent statement under different terminology.
title: Sharp field-and-dimension transition for Gaussian kernels on projective incidence metrics
